definitions.gloss: one after another, in quick succession
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something continuously and without pause, often implying abundance or lack of restraint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じゃんじゃん⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Orders came pouring in one after another.

examples.japanese: じゃんじゃん⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: To spend money freely without restraint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧じゃんじゃん⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you have questions, please ask away!

examples.japanese: ⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧じゃんじゃん⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They're developing new products one after another.

notes:
じゃんじゃん is an onomatopoeic adverb suggesting the sound of continuous action (like a ringing bell or cymbal). It implies doing something freely, abundantly, and without hesitation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- じゃんじゃん⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (use freely/spend freely)
- じゃんじゃん⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (come pouring in)
- じゃんじゃん⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧/⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (speak/ask without hesitation)
- じゃんじゃん⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (do without restraint)

REGISTER: Casual/colloquial. Often used in spoken Japanese.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どんどん→どんどん：01261_dondon⟧: One after another (neutral)
- ⟦ばんばん→ばんばん：06179_banban⟧: Vigorously, without hesitation
- じゃんじゃん: Freely, abundantly (implies no restraint)
